programme.desc: Tyson still can't get over losing his town's Beyblade Tournament to the mysterious Mister X. Kenny and Dizzi try to come up with some answers but discover a greater mystery. On the same day as Tyson's loss, Max and Ray were also visited by similar shadowy figures that defeated them as well. While Tyson does his best to avoid his school chores, Kenny makes a startling discovery about Mister X's Beyblade. Unfortunately Tyson, unaware of this new information, unexpectedly runs into Mister X at the park and challenges him to a rematch!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson heads to the park to meet Kenny, who has a plan to get Dragoon back 'on line'. But when Kenny and Hilary are kidnapped, Tyson is forced to jump through a series of hoops set out by their captors, which test his speed and determination. After successfully completing their orders, Tyson finds himself on a ship equipped with a fancy computer system ' and his friends, locked in a glass-walled cage. But what do the kidnappers want ' and how far will they go to get it?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Kenny are safe on dry land once again but are totally baffled trying to figure out why Kenny and Hilary were kidnapped by two mystery men. The best that they can deduce is that two factions are out to steal the Bit Beasts of all the members of the BladeBreakers. This leads them to wonder about Kai who supposedly has retired.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Inside Gideon's training center two of his henchmen discover a talented Blader named Snakey and offer to equip his Blade with the Magtram. The Magtram is a device that creates a magnetic field around the user's Beyblade and gives an unfair advantage to anyone using it. Kenny and Hilary are on the look out for their mysterious captors when Tyson shows up with a new scheme to find Ozuma. Out of nowhere, Snakey shows up and challenges Tyson to a match.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Kenny try to determine what the mystery material was inside Snakey's Beyblade that made it so magnetic. Kai is tight-lipped after rejoining his friends following his draw against Dunga. Kai crashes at Tyson's place, but departs quickly after old grievances resurface, and Hilary suspects him of being a spy. Tyson and Kenny e-mail Max's Mom, asking for help with their analysis of the mystery metal, while Hilary suggests visiting another person who could help them - Mr. Dickenson.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: At long last, Max and Ray rejoin their friends and the Bladebreakers are back together again! Just in time to meet their opponents, Team Psykick. With one week to train, the guys have victory on their brains ' especially after Max and Kenny reveal the new technology developed by Max's mom. The MG Core produces a magnetic field similar to the one in the Magtram technology, giving the user optimal control over their Beyblade and increasing the Beyblades power ten fold. However, it's not an easy thing to control, and the guys have a rough start.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers were on route to take on Team Psykick in a tournament when the Driver filled the bus with sleeping gas. While unconscious, they were quickly whisked away to a deserted island where Doctor B, Gideon's minion, was assigned to steal the Bit Beasts from all four team members with a Bit-Beast Capturing System.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers are trapped on a mysterious island and not sure how to get off, so they decide to split up. Hilary, Kai and Kenny head for the lighthouse where they hope to find a way to communicate with the outside world and call for help, while Tyson, Ray and Max accidentally find themselves at the site of their next battle. Kai's gang faces difficult obstacles when their mysterious captor tries to dissuade them from reaching the lighthouse, and they barely escape in one piece.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Our heroes are still trapped on a deserted island and are puppets of the evil Doctor B who's intent is to steal the Bladebreakers Bit Beasts. But he does make a deal with the kids that if each member of the Bladebreakers can defeat a member of Team Psykick, he'll release them. Only two haven't fought yet- Tyson and Kai. The first battle is between Kai and Figel that Kai wins handily. After the battle, Kenny, Kai and Hilary resume their quest to the lighthouse to get a clear satellite signal to get help from the outside. Finally they make contact, but not before they return to find Tyson in battle against another member of Team Psykick, Daryl.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson recuperates in the hospital after being rescued from the island where he fought Team Psykick. Away from school, Tyson discovers he really likes hospital life until Hilary shows up with all his homework assignments. Meanwhile Gideon, frustrated with his attempts to capture the BladeBreakers Bit Beasts, hatches a sinister new plan. He demands that Doctor B and his team create powerful Cyber Bit Beasts using the data they have gathered on the Blade Breakers. The only problem is their data is incomplete.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Joseph of the Saint Shields infiltrates the Psykick's laboratory and discovers their latest, sinister plan. Gideon and Doctor B are using the data they collected on the Blade Breakers to create Cyber Bit-Beasts based on the ones our heroes use. But the Doctor's first test ends in disaster; the Cyber Bit Beasts aren't quite ready yet. As for the BladeBreakers, they learn that the group who've been using invisible Bit Beasts against them - the Saint Shields - are all in the vicinity.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Our heroes have been confronted by Joseph and Mariam and just as Tyson runs up, Ozuma, the Saint Shields leader, challenges Tyson to a battle. As it rages on, Tyson is forced to call out his Victory Tornado Attack in order to win. After the fight, Ozuma flippantly tells Tyson he needs to 'improve his Bit Beast Technique' which stumps Tyson to no end, especially after winning!! Meanwhile, Gideon oversees Doctor B who unveils the first ever Cyber Bit Beast which is the most powerful Beast in the world. This cloned power from the Sacred Bit Beasts has been compressed into one blade. But first it has to be tested and Gerry, one of the best Blader's Team Psykick has to offer, is chosen. His mission is to enter a local tournament and draw out the Cyber Beast in battle to see how it handles. Oddly enough, the BladeBreakers show up at the same tournament just as Gerry calls out his Bit Beast. This is when things go horribly wrong as the Beast goes totally out of control and self destructs leaving the BladeBreakers to wonder what Team Psykick are up to!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Gerry of Team Psychic's lack of control led to an explosive conclusion when his Cyber Bit Beast blew up. The Blade Breakers were at a loss as to how that could happen so Kenny consulted his trusty laptop Dizzi and made a startling revelation. Someone had managed to make copies of the Blade Breakers Bit Beasts! This discovery leads the gang to believe that new powerful Bit Beasts are being developed and they decide to get themselves in shape for battle. Ozuma and his gang, the Saint Shields, are still eager to test the power of the Blade Breakers' Bit Beasts as well, so they head to the beach where Tyson and the others are training. Meanwhile Doctor B is busy experimenting with various versions of a Cyber Bit Beast with mixed results.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Kai's classmate Wyatt returns and begs Kai to help him train to become a first-class Beyblader. Remembering the time back at school that Wyatt betrayed Kai by stealing Dranzer and using it in battle, Kai turns him down. Hurt, Wyatt vows to return and battle Kai one day. That day may be sooner than anyone thinks' for the mysterious Dr. B and his team of scientists have finally re-developed the Cyber Bit Beast and are looking for a Blader with the skill to handle it. Dr. B approaches Wyatt with an offer to join Team Psykick, and Wyatt jumps at the chance.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After Dunga and Wyatt battle, Wyatt realizes he doesn't possess the skill necessary to control his Cyber Bit Beast. This frustrates Gideon, so he commands Doctor B to seek out a suitable candidate for the job. Meanwhile, Tyson is back home practicing his blading and quickly tires of it. The rest of the BladeBreakers, including Hilary, keep harping on him to continue until he gets it right. But Tyson has had enough and quits! It seems the BladeBreakers are finished! Then, Hilary comes up with an idea! She tells the guys to take a day off and invites them to an afternoon barbecue with Grandpa playing the part of the Chef. At first Tyson wants nothing to do with it, but finally he relents and joins in. After lunch, the kids relax by the river while Grandpa fishes. Suddenly he hooks a big one and gets dragged in the water! The kids run to the rescue, however, a group of four new teenagers appear out of nowhere and rescue Gramps. After a brief conversation, our heroes realize these new kids are also Bladers, so Tyson challenges their leader, Kane, to a battle. After a fierce fight, it ends in a tie and the new kids leave. Tyson thinks he made a new friend, but as it turns out, Kane is the leader of the Psykick's and is in cahoots with the evil Gideon!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Kane, Goki, Jim, and Salima arrive at Doctor B's lab to begin battle tests for Gideon. Jim goes first after being given his new Beyblade, Cyber Draciel. He battles against a lopsided number of automated Beyblades, including one behemoth the size of a football. But with Cyber Draciel in tow, victory is decisive. It's obvious however, that the Cyber Bit-Beast's power is having a corrupting influence on Jim. At Mr. Dickenson's office, the BladeBreakers are blackmailed into a future battle against the Psykick's when Doctor B threatens an all-out assault on the city by the Cyber Bit-Beasts. When Tyson hears that his new friend Kane has joined the Psykick's, he refuses to believe it without concrete proof.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After seeing the power of the Cyber Bit Beasts in Team Psykick's Beyblades, Tyson vows to do whatever it takes to beat them. Even if that means breaking the rules and modifying his own Beyblade. Ray protests and demands that the BladeBreakers play fair even if the odds are against them. In a quiet moment down by the river he runs into Salima of Team Psykick and discovers she feels the same way as he does. Salima tries to convince Ray to get the BladeBreakers to forfeit their upcoming match and even offers to reveal the secrets of the Cyber Bit Beasts.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson is so determined to beat the Psykick's in an upcoming battle that he's ordered Kenny to modify his Dragoon beyond legal specifications. But because his blade now has too much offensive power, Tyson is unable to control it and he becomes totally frustrated with himself and his blade. The more he tries controlling it, the worse he becomes. His friends try to tell him 'cheating' isn't the way to win, yet Tyson ignores them and being pigheaded as he is, he goes off to sulk about his dilemma.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Blade Breakers travel by helicopter to their re-match against the Psykick's. During the flight, Hilary remembers how Psykick trapped her and Kenny on a cargo ship; Max ponders their recent training; Kai regrets the Psykick' mistreatment of Wyatt;; Ray recalls the time Salima reached out to him; and Tyson remains bitter about Kane joining Psykick. When they arrive at the battle location - a five-story, monolithic building called 'The Battle Tower' - they're greeted by Gideon via video screen, who outlines the format. On each floor, one Psykick awaits a different Blade Breaker, and each match will be a one-match-only sudden death battle.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The first battle between Team Psykick and the Bladebreakers has begun! Max fights bravely against Jim and Cyber Draciel' and his teammates aren't the only ones interested in the outcome of the battle. Dr. B and Gideon watch from the sidelines, and the Saint Sheilds are there to watch their backs. Max defeats Jim, but amazingly, Cyber Draciel is repaired!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: A confused and heartbroken Ray must face Salima in a dangerous challenge of Drigers! Despite the threat of losing his bit-beast forever, Ray hesitates' baffled by the extreme change in Salima's personality. It wasn't long ago that she confided in Ray and told him of the troubling bit-beast experiments being conducted by the Psykick's' and now' it looks like she's in the same boat as Goki and Jim! Mind-Controlled by their own cyber-bit-beasts! But Ray can't stand back for long' not after realizing his team is depending on him' and even in the face of team Psykick's blatant cheating' Ray refuses to back down' he's not just fighting for a win' he's fighting to bring back the Salima he once knew!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Thanks to Ray's spectacular victory over Salima, the Bladebreakers reach the fourth level of Gideon's Battle Tower and meet their next opponent, Goki of the Psykick's. As Kai steps forward to meet the challenge Gideon and Doctor B prepare several surprises for the team. Using the information gathered from the previous two Beybattles, Doctor B has programmed Driger and Draciel's attack patterns into Goki's Beyblade. Meanwhile, the Saint Shields continue to explore the Psykick's headquarters in an attempt to find Max's captured Draciel.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Meanwhile, Ozuma and his gang have barged into the laboratory complex to help Tyson, however, because the building is so massive, they can't find the right room! They frantically split up and race to find their friends. Back in the battle, Tyson's words have hit a chord with Kane and he decides not to call out the Cyber Dragoon to fight for him. Instead, he wants to win it on his own. Gideon and Doctor B are incensed, but because Kane wants to win so badly, he accidentally triggers the Cyber Bit Beast to launch and now the battle has taken a turn for the worse as it grows in power' at least for Tyson!!"

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson faces off against Kane of Team Psykick and soon realizes his opponent has an unnatural advantage. Thanks to Doctor B, Kane has a powerful Cyber Bit Beast inside of his Blade. This means that when Tyson summons Dragoon, Kane's Cyber Bit Beast has the ability to copy Dragoon's moves and even improve on them. It's obvious from the get go that Kane's Cyber Bit Beast's powers are developing at an alarming rate and when it starts controlling his mind that's when things really get out of hand. Although a good Blader in his own right, under the control of the Cyber Bit Beast Kane's personality begins to change and when he's confronted by Salima he snaps and totally succumbs to its power.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Cyber Dragoon is blown to oblivion, so is the building they are in and it starts collapsing all around them. Our heroes make a mad dash for the exits when, Max realizes his Draciel is still being held captive in the lab. Max races back inside followed closely by Tyson. Once inside the lab, they meet up with Ozuma and his gang who free Draciel for Max using their blades. Now it's a race to try and get out of the building safely!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After the kids arrive in NYC, Max's mother, Judy, takes them to the BBA research lab where she shows them an ancient rock, covered in mysterious writing. Judy reveals that not only is the rock believed to hold the secret of the Bit Beasts, but an organized crime syndicate is plotting to steal it. A test battle is fought, using a bit containing a piece of the rock but the power it produces is far too unstable. The Blader who performed the test turns out to be Max's school friend, Alan, and the two pals make plans to enter a Beyblade tournament scheduled for the next day. But that night, the rock is stolen. Tyson grabs a bike and sets off in hot pursuit, using a practice blade to blow out the getaway car's tire. The thieves take off on foot and Max runs into them only to discover that his pal, Alan, is in on the plot.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Alan tells Max that if Max wins, he'll explain why he agreed to steal the rock with a bunch of shady thieves. The battle is heated and Max is determined to win. After one draw and several close calls, Max finally wins. In the end Alan explains that he was approached by some underworld characters who convinced him if he stole the rock they would give him a new, more powerful Beyblade . But the new blade turns out to be a dud and Alan is left to explain why he did what he did to Max!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: When the kids return to Japan accompanied by Judy, they are taken to an abandoned research facility where Mr. Dickenson had once worked on a similar rock with his old partner, Dr. Zagart. Like the one that was stolen from the BBA, this rock was covered in mysterious writing and possessed strange powers. Unfortunately, it too disappeared, along with Dr. Zagart who was never seen again. After a battle with Kenny and his new 'Einstein' Beyblade, Tyson realizes he still has to learn how to control his new, ultra-powerful Beyblade, Dragoon V2. While practicing down by the river, he is challenged to a battle by Ozuma and the Saint Shields. Tyson accepts and manages to hold his own until the entire Saint Shields clan gangs up on him. It looks like all is lost until a mysterious stranger steps in to save the battle and the day. But the Saint Shields vow to return and fulfill their mission to capture and seal the four Bit Beasts.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Mr. Dickenson and Max's Mom show up at Tyson's dojo empty-handed. Dr. Zagart and the mysterious rock have vanished without a trace. Knowing Dr. Zagart is the key to finding the missing rock, the BladeBreakers decide to launch their own search. One problem, they have no idea where to start looking. Meanwhile Dr. Zagart and Dr. K have designed a new powerful Blade using the rock, and they've chosen a Blader named Foxy to challenge our heroes. While Tyson is busy with Zeo, the boy he met the day before when he fought Ozuma, Foxy attacks. Never one to turn down a challenge Ray follows Foxy into the woods. Foxy's rock powered Blade nearly destroys Ray's Blade but Tyson shows up in the nick of time and coaches Ray to victory. The BladeBreakers congratulate Ray on his victory but the Saint Shields also witnessed the battle. Intrigued, Ozuma vows more than ever to get the BladeBreakers four Bit Beasts!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: In the quiet after Foxy's storm, the BladeBreakers try to figure out who or what was behind his attack, and how it all tied into the mysterious Rock. Meanwhile, Tyson reaches a breaking point, discouraged and upset by the constant attempts of fanatic groups trying to steal the sacred bit-beasts. His anxiety goes overboard when he coaxes Kenny to create a wacky training platform for the team to practice with. He takes his jaded attitude out on Zeo, who simply wants to spar with one of the greats. At the same time, The Saint Shields' frustration level also grows, as Ozuma decides that the Bladebreakers are unworthy of possessing the sacred bit-beasts any longer. Tyson remembers the simple joys of Beyblading when he finally agrees to train with Zeo and coaches him so he can pass his Beyblading exam. The proud feeling that Tyson gets may just be enough to get him and his team through these tough times'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Mr. Dickenson deciphers the words that are carved onto the mysterious rocks and reads the kids this warning; 'Dare not disturb this stone, for here, the Bit Beasts are sealed.' The kids realize that the Saint Shields are part of a clan which still uses this ancient language and they resolve to confront them, even if it means battling and losing their Beyblades in the bargain. Ozuma reveals the history of the Bit Beasts to the Bladebreakers, telling of them of their origin as benevolent spirits until evil men discovered how to control them and use them for their own malicious needs. Since that time, the clan of the Saint Shields has made it their mission to seal the Bit Beasts and save the world from destruction. Dunga issues a battle challenge to the Bladebreakers and Ray answers it with confidence, but Dunga's new Vortex Ape proves too much for Driger. After Ray's Bit Beast is taken, the team goes into training but will they be able to save Driger without putting themselves into further jeopardy?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Meanwhile, Doctor K has extracted a Spider Bit Beast from the rock and gives it to a new Blader named Net whose mission is to go out and capture Tyson's Dragoon. As Tyson races to a Junior Beyblade Tournament, Net cuts him off and draws him into battle. During the fight, Net keeps telling Tyson to release his Dragoon so he can steal it, but when Tyson finally does, Dragoon wins and Net runs away crying. In the end, Zeo absorbs the lesson taught to him by the BladeBreakers who invite him to train with them."

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Kai is busy practicing his Beyblade skills alone in the park when out of nowhere a gust of wind appears and starts slicing everything to pieces. It turns out that it's the work of Jack, one of Dr. K's Blader's, and he's got a Bit Beast that harnesses the wind. Once the BladeBreakers figure this out, Ray volunteers to fight, but Kai stops him and sneaks out in the middle of the night to battle Jack. Discovering Kai is gone, the gang runs and finds him just as he's about to begin the battle. The gang realizes Kai doesn't stand a chance against this wind Bit Beast because he can't see it. Reluctantly they let Kai fight. An intense battle ensues and Kai takes a severe beating as he waits to catch a glimpse of Jack's Bit Beast. Finally Kai summons Dranzer and spots the wind Bit Beast and defeats it. Defeated, Jack runs off while Kai leaves the rest of BladeBreakers in awe as he walks off into the night.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Goaded by Dunga, Mariam goes off to capture Max's Draciel and finds him battling Dennis and his Bit Beast, Tyranno. Using his new Bit Finder Kenny measures Tyranno's impressive strength and is surprised when Dennis backs out of the battle before using its full power. Unaware that Mariam is following him, Max runs off in pursuit of Dennis and finds himself deep in the bowels of a mysterious building. He is ambushed by Dennis- who is now backed up by Dr. K and her Technicians. Mariam lies in wait, planning on taking Draciel once Tyranno weakens him. But when she discovers that Dr. K is using Power Injection to make Tyranno even stronger, Mariam launches Sharkrash and destroys the machinery and much of the building with it. It is now up to Max and Mariam to work together to find a way out of the crumbling building. But will Mariam capture Draciel once they escape?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Fed up with all the recent attempts by Zagart and others to acquire the BladeBreakers Bit Beasts for sinister purposes, The Saint Shields decide to take action. Having already acquired Ray's Bit-Beast Driger in an earlier match, the Saint Shields confront our heroes again. They challenge the BladeBreakers to a match at an abandoned amusement park. The BladeBreakers know that if they lose, The Saint Shields will seal their Bit Beasts away forever in a mysterious rock to prevent them from being used for evil.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: But just when things start to heat up, Ray launches his blade to try to even the score. As the battle rages, the roller coaster collapses around all the blades and it appears our heroes are done for, especially since Ray is fighting without his Driger! But Ray is determined not to lose again and using his amazing powers of concentration, he's able to release his Bit Beast from the rock and with it, Ray and Kai defeat their opponents. The battle ends in victory just as Ozuma, who is furious, steps up and warns Tyson his Dragoon will be the next to be sealed!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Ozuma, leader of the Saint Shields gang makes a final play for the BladeBreakers four Bit Beasts. During his battle with Tyson, it is revealed that he comes from an ancient group that is sworn to capture and contain all the Bit Beasts in the world. Thus protecting them from falling into the wrong hands and being used for evil purposes. However, once the battle heats up Ozuma's jealousy of Tyson's Beyblading skill takes him over. Pulling out all the stops, he forces Tyson to decide to give up the battle and surrender his Bit Beast or have his Blade destroyed. In a quiet moment of reflection, Tyson communicates with Dragoon and they decide to fight the good fight no matter what the result. Tyson and Dragoon lock horns with Ozuma's Bit Beast and weave a path of destruction on the playing field. When the dust settles the match is declared a tie and Ozuma realizes that Tyson and the BladeBreakers are worthy enough to look after the four Bit Beasts on their own. The Saint Shields say their goodbyes and walk away content that the four Bit Beasts are in good hands!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Pleased that the Saint Shields no longer wish to seal the four Bit Beasts, Dr. K gives a new Blader, Denny, a powerful rock Bit Beast named Clarken and orders him to capture the four Sacred Bit Beasts. Meanwhile, Zeo catches up with the Bladebreakers and shows them his invitation to the upcoming World Championships.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The BladeBreakers show up at the World Championship Tournament and go up into the stands to cheer on Zeo who's fighting in the preliminaries. Tyson is pumped watching his new friend who wins his first fight with ease. Later backstage, Tyson tells Zeo he's totally impressed and asks if Zeo would like to become his training partner. Zeo excitedly agrees. Meanwhile back at Zagart's lab, Doctor K is on the verge of removing the strongest Bit Beast in the world from the rock. But just before she can finish, Zagart enters and terminates her on the spot. That night at Zeo's house, his dad returns from work. The shocker here is, guess who his dad is? That's right, Zagart!! And what's worse, an angry Doctor K shows up to confront her former boss in his house and as she does, Zeo overhears the entire conversation. Now Zeo realizes it's his dad who's been after the BladeBreakers Bit Beasts and his world is thrown into chaos!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Zeo focuses on Beyblade training with his father Zagart. The most powerful rock Bit-Beast named Cerberus is designated for Zeo, but he must first be able to summon it. Zeo trains furiously, but the elusive Bit Beast never fully materializes. Meanwhile, the Bladebreakers must choose their two team-pairs for the World Beyblade Championships. Hilary brings in a pile of her fortune-telling books to help. They decide that Tyson will team with Max, and Kai with Ray. Not long afterward, Kai meets a strange pair named King and Queen, who are very impressed by Dranzer. They talk Kai into battling them, with Dranzer's attack ring up for grabs if they win. To Kai's surprise, not only do they have Bit Beasts of their own, but they're not above tag-teaming him to avoid defeat. By the end of the battle, Dranzer is so damaged that its attack ring is useless, which sends King and Queen on their way empty-handed. When Kai discusses the incident with his BladeBreaker teammates, it's discovered that King and Queen are infamous 'parts hunters' - Blader's who search for high-end Beyblade parts from others that they can acquire for themselves. Back at Zagart's lab, Zeo tries summoning Cerberus one last time ' and succeeds. Cerberus is a massively powerful canine Bit Beast with three snarling heads. Zeo can't wait to use it against the Bladebreakers to acquire their Bit Beasts, which are necessary to fulfill his mysterious and still-unrevealed destiny.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: While all that the Bladebreakers can think of are the finals, Kai can't stop obsessing about King and Queen. With a brand new Beyblade crafted for him by Max, Kai longs for a rematch. But Kai isn't the only one with the royal pair on his mind. Doctor K tracks the duo down and offers them a chance to team up with her so they can capture and wield the power of the four sacred Bit Beasts together. The pair blow her off, interested only in their quests for stealing the perfect Beyblade parts. That is, until they meet up with Kai once more. In a coincidental encounter, Kai gets his wish for revenge. But before he tastes victory, the two disappear! Who knows where they'll turn up again but chances are good, Doctor K. won't be too far behind'

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: Hohenheim's visit ends with a grave warning to Pinako, but Ed finds hope among the charred ruins of his childhood. Now more than ever, he has confidence that Al can be returned to his body.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: Hoping to learn more about the Homunculi, Ed and Al devise a risky strategy to lure the creatures out of hiding. Step one of the brothers' plan: risk death at the hands of their most dangerous enemy - Scar.

programme.title: Terror in Resonance [English Dub]
programme.desc: Tokyo is suddenly hit by a massive bombing. Two young men who call themselves “Sphinx” start an epic game involving the whole of Japan.

programme.title: Terror in Resonance [English Dub]
programme.desc: Tokyo is suddenly hit by a massive bombing. Two young men who call themselves “Sphinx” start an epic game involving the whole of Japan.

programme.title: Terror in Resonance [English Dub]
programme.desc: Tokyo is suddenly hit by a massive bombing. Two young men who call themselves “Sphinx” start an epic game involving the whole of Japan.

programme.title: Hunter x Hunter: Phantom Rouge [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: The Battle Olympia begins! Gon and team attend, but The Shadow puts a deadly end to the festivities!

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: When Dr. Eggman learns that Knuckles has just discovered the oldest map in the world, which holds the location of the lost continent of Murasia, he sends Decoe and Bocoe on a mission to take the map away from Knuckles.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: Sonic and his friends are in pursuit of Dr. Eggman, who has fled into the volcano which lies at the world's bellybutton. They come upon the Murasians ruin which attributed its destruction to a supposed dragon god.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: Dr. Bickley discovers that Sonic's world and theirs were once one and the same. As the two world slowly completes its reunification, she realizes that the process would ultimately cause time to stop. The only solution? Send Sonic and everyone back home.

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: With everyone back in their home worlds the crisis has been averted, and all seems to be back to normal. Except, no one seems to know where Sonic is. His friends and even Eggman begin to wonder where he might be.

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: According to legend, a stamp named the Cinderella Shadow is said to make its owner a princess. Lupin and his gang pull off the heist, but a girl name Alice who also wants the stamp tags along. A clever and very persistent Alice proves to be a major headache for Lupin. Will the little girl get her royal wish?

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Lupin has sent a notice declaring he will steal all the cash from every bank in Paris. Detective Melon, the granddaughter of Inspector Garimard, is chosen to catch Lupin alongside Inspector Zenigata. Inspector Garimard was the original Lupin's rival, and now their grandchildren are about to square off. Where will the chase lead the two rivals?

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Lord En might be more interested in destroying his opponents at video games than destroying humanity, but his personal army, Behemoth's 34 Pillar Division, has other plans... So when one of the Pillars shows up and tries to make a blood contract with Kunieda, it's up to Oga and Hilda to rescue her.

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Hecadoth, one of Behemoth's 34 Pillars, was after Oga all along! Does he stand a chance against a battle-hardened Demon? Meanwhile, Tojo and Izuma's grudge match is interrupted by another pair of Demons. But coming to the rescue is... Kanzaki?!

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Oga, frustrated with his loss to Behemoth's minions, decides he has to train to get stronger. But joining Kunieda's grandfather's dojo to train might not be the best idea…

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A special forces team bursts in to apprehend Shishigami. Shion and her grandmother are shot in the crossfire, and Shishigami manages to grab them before escaping. That night, Shishigami attacks a police station in vengeance.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: As the news reports on Shishigami's attack on the police station, Shishigami hijacks a broadcast signal to publicly declare war on Japan, claiming he will kill 100 people immediately. Undeterred, Shishigami continues his killing, and announces he will kill 1000 tomorrow, devastating Inuyashiki.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]

Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: As the news reports on Shishigami's attack on the police station, Shishigami hijacks a broadcast signal to publicly declare war on Japan, claiming he will kill 100 people immediately. Ando realizes Shishigami's plans and manages to thwart it with the help of Inuyashiki's power. Undeterred, Shishigami continues his killing, and announces he will kill 1000 tomorrow, devastating Inuyashiki.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: The day after the mass killings in Shinjuku, Shishigami begins dropping airplanes onto the city. After receiving word from Ando, Inuyashiki manages to stop a number of them from crashing. He then notices that Mari is trapped inside a burning building, but Shishigami appears and attacks him. Inuyashiki is desperately trying to make his way over to save Mari, but Shishigami is right on his heels.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Saving many lives in Shinjuku, Inuyashiki returns home to open up to his family about his robot body. His family accepts him, and they embrace. After losing both arms, Shishigami goes to Ando who condemns him and Shishigami disappears. Inuyashiki finds out a giant meteor is about to hit earth. With the whole world in chaos, Inuyashiki flys towards the meteor to protect his family.

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kid's first order of business is saving himself and an unconscious, handcuffed Aoko as they plummet from the top of Toto Tower in an antique car. Assuming he succeeds, the next challenge is finishing his mother's last job, bringing a crooked antiques dealer to justice. But his mother never had to deal with the brilliant diminutive detective, Edogawa Conan!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.desc: The Detective Conan crossover concludes with a night at the museum, in which Kid goes out of his way to return stolen items amid a crowd of adoring fans, the police who want to take him down, and a couple of real criminals!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.desc: When the greedy owner of a department store has an employee impersonate Kid the Phantom Thief to steal the Star of the Giants, he doesn't count on the real Kid showing up on Christmas Eve to foil his plan!

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: The Elrics come face to face with Father - and his face is familiar indeed. Powerless and amazed, Ed and Al can only watch as Father creates a new Homunculus with alchemy that should be impossible.

programme.desc: Rick llega a caballo a Atlanta, donde encuentra una ciudad desolada. Tras escapar de una situación de peligro, Rick se une a un grupo de supervivientes en unos grandes almacenes, donde le espera un enemigo más peligroso que los zombis.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick regresa a Atlanta al sentirse culpable de haber dejado a Merle abandonado en un edificio asolado por zombis. En el campamento, la inesperada llegada de Rick causa tensión entre Lori y Shane, quien había asegurado que Rick había muerto.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: En Atlanta, una banda armada sorprende al grupo de Rick mientras están buscando a Merle. Entretanto, en el campamento, Jim empieza a comportarse de forma extraña, tiene premoniciones y asusta a los niños con una tragedia que se aproxima.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Tras el ataque al campamento, Rick conduce al grupo hacia el CDC, un recinto de la base sanitaria militar, en el que esperan encontrar un refugio seguro. Durante el trayecto, Jim debe tomar una decisión extremadamente difícil.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Un científico inquietante deja entrar a Rick y su grupo en el CDC. No obstante, hay algo extraño y los supervivientes del apocalipsis zombi empiezan a sospechar que no todo es lo que parece en el recinto.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo, liderado por Rick, se topa con una horda de zombis en mitad de la autopista. La pequeña Sophia, asustada, huye sola al bosque y todos tratarán de encontrarla antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick encuentra una granja en la que buscar ayuda para salvar la vida de su hijo, quien recibió el impacto accidental de una bala. Después, Shane entra en una escuela llena de zombis para llevarse material sanitario junto al tipo que disparó a Carl.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Shane y Otis están atrapados por los zombis en la escuela adonde acudieron por el material sanitario necesario para operar a Carl. En la granja, surgen las primeras tensiones y Daryl y Andrea vuelven a salir en busca de Sophie.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Shane regresa a la granja con las medicinas, pero el sacrificio que ha tenido que cometer no es bien visto por el resto del grupo. En la granja, el grupo intenta sacar a un zombi del pozo de agua fresca antes de que la infecte.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Mientras busca a Sophia, Daryl sufre un accidente que lo deja perdido y herido en el bosque. La tensión entre el grupo y los propietarios de la granja aumenta, así como la inestabilidad del propio grupo, debido a que Shane desafía a Rick.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Tras descubrir que la familia mantiene encerrada a sus familiares convertidos en zombis en el granero, Dale confronta a Hershel. Lori, por su parte, confiesa a Rick que está embarazada y los problemas entre los integrantes del grupo se intensifican.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Glenn le revela a todo el grupo el secreto del granero, pero no están de acuerdo sobre cómo actuar: Rick ordena respetar la autoridad de Hershel, aunque Shane quiere acabar con los zombis. Por otra parte, descubren por fin qué le ha pasado a Sophia.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Hershel no soporta lo ocurrido y recae en su alcoholismo, pero Rick y Glenn lo siguen hasta la ciudad para evitar que muera. Entretanto, Beth, incapaz de aceptar todo lo que le está sucediendo a su familia, entra en estado catatónico.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Lori sale en busca de Rick, pero lo único que encuentra es un peligro mortal y Shane va tras ella. Entretanto, Rick, Hershel y Glenn mantienen un tiroteo con los desconocidos con quienes cruzaron sus caminos en el bar.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: La tensión entre Rick y Shane aumenta y la decisión sobre el destino de Randall es el detonante: Shane quiere matarlo, Rick prefiere dejarlo vivo. Mientras, Beth pretende suicidarse y Andrea, quien debe vigilarla, no cumple con su cometido.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo descubre que Randall es un violador y asesino y acuerdan ejecutarlo, pero Dale se opone porque eso los convertiría también en criminales. Mientras tanto, Carl comete un error que acarreará consecuencias imprevistas.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Las diferencias entre Rick y Shane por el liderato del grupo y la gestión de la granja se intensifican cuando Shane decide por su cuenta el destino de Randall. La tensión termina estallando y los dos amigos se enfrentan a muerte.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Una horda de zombis invade la granja y el grupo intenta escapar vivo entre el caos, pero no todos lo lograrán. Además, Rick se harta de las quejas del grupo y les da un ultimátum: si quieren que sea el líder, acatarán sus órdenes.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick y Morgan encuentran una horda descomunal de zombis en una cantera cercana a Alejandría. Entretanto, Carter convoca a varios habitantes de Alejandría para proponerles un plan: matar a Rick.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Los Lobos, el grupo con el que ya habían combatido, asalta Alejandría y empieza a acuchillar a sus ciudadanos por las calles. Durante la pelea, Enid huye de Alejandría y Ron rechaza la ayuda de Rick.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo trata de reconducir a la horda de zombis para alejarla de Alejandría, pero el plan falla y Glenn y Nicholas terminan rodeados por muertos vivientes. Rick, por su parte, es atacado por los asaltantes que Morgan expulsó de Alejandría.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Morgan le explica a un asaltante al que mantiene cautivo cómo venció a la ira que le consumía y aprendió que el camino correcto es aquel que rechaza la violencia.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick regresa a Alejandría, donde el ánimo está decaído por la presencia de la horda de zombis y las secuelas del asalto sufrido. Maggie y Aarón salen en busca de Glenn. Denise pierde la confianza en sí misma, pero Tara la anima.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Daryl se separa de Abraham y Sasha mientras regresan a Alejandría. Un trío de fugitivos captura a Daryl, aunque él trata de convencerlos de que se unan a su comunidad.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Glenn encuentra a Enid y la convence de regresar junto a él a Alexandria. Mientras, en la comunidad, Ron roba armas del arsenal y Carol se enfrenta a Morgan porque no confía en él.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: La horda de zombis invade Alejandría a través de la grieta que se produjo en el muro. Rick, Michonne, Carl, Gabriel y Deanna se ocultan en la casa de Jessie, pero se dan cuenta de que están rodeados.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Ahora que los caminantes han traspasado las barreras de Alejandría, Rick y los otros sobrevivientes deben seguir luchando para mantenerse a salvo e intentar no perder la esperanza.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo cree que estar en el lado de los vivos trae responsabilidades que van más allá de la supervivencia. Desde esta perspectiva, Rick comienza una lucha consigo mismo para preservar las huellas de lo que queda de humanidad.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo de Rick acompaña a Jesús a su comunidad, La Cumbre. Allí, un residente intenta matar a Gregory, el líder, por órdenes de Negan. Maggie hace un pacto con Gregory: matarán a Negan a cambio de la mitad de las provisiones que guardan.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo se prepara para su más feroz batalla y los caminos de Rick y Morgan se alejan. Mientras tanto, el pasado de Carol regresa para acecharla.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Tras haber obtenido un éxito menor, algunos de los miembros del grupo han sido hechos prisioneros por sus nuevos enemigos y el resto de los supervivientes de Alejandría tendrá que tratar de liberarlos.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Abraham abandona a Eugene durante una misión porque él le dice que no necesita su protección. Daryl, Rosita y Denise se topan con un grupo de los Salvadores, dirigidos por Dwight, y entre los dos bandos se produce un tiroteo.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Carol desaparece de Alejandría y toda la comunidad se coordina para localizarla. Sin embargo, lo que algunos de ellos encuentran no es lo que andaban buscando.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Para salvar a Maggie, que se encuentra enferma, el grupo de Rick se aventura fuera de los muros de Alejandría. Pero los hombres de Negan los están esperando en la carretera.

programme.title: Interview With the Vampire
programme.desc: En 1910, en Nueva Orleans, la vida de Louis de Pointe du Lac, hasta entonces administrador de la fortuna de su familia, cambia por completo al conocer al vampiro Lestat. En 2020, Louis le narra la historia de su vida a un periodista.

programme.title: Interview With the Vampire
programme.desc: Louis empieza a aprender la realidad del vampirismo de la mano de su maestro y compañero, Lestat, pero, poco a poco, se da cuenta de que entre ellos dos hay diferencias. En el presente, en Dubái, Louis le revela nuevos secretos a Molloy.

programme.title: Interview With the Vampire
programme.desc: La llegada de un viejo amigo pone en peligro la relación de Louis y Lestat. La vida como vampiro de Louis se ve afectada por el creciente malestar social que se respira en Nueva Orleans, el cual repercute en sus negocios.

programme.title: Interview With the Vampire
programme.desc: La transformación de Claudia en vampiro cambia las vidas de Louis y Lestat. A medida que Claudia hace más preguntas, Louis y Lestat se ven obligados a enfrentarse a sus dudas. Claudia descubre las realidades de su nueva vida.

programme.title: Interview With the Vampire
programme.desc: Claudia se va de la casa para formarse académicamente e investigar acerca del vampirismo. En la época de la Gran Depresión, la hermana de Louis se pone en contacto con él y la tensión estalla con el regreso de Claudia.

programme.title: Interview With the Vampire
programme.desc: Lestat intenta hacer las paces con Louis y la familia de vampiros decide vivir junta una vez más. Un acto impulsivo de Lestat lleva a la familia a decidir abandonar Nueva Orleans, de una vez por todas.

programme.title: Interview With the Vampire
programme.desc: La familia de vampiros planea abandonar la ciudad al terminar un gran baile de Mardi Gras, pero Claudia y Louis se mantienen al margen del conocimiento de Lestat. Mientras, en Dubai, Louis revela un nuevo detalle en la entrevista que lo cambia todo.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Se descubre contra quién ha ejecutado Negan su venganza. Después, lleva a Rick a hacer un viaje que este no olvidará jamás, con la intención de mostrarle hasta dónde llega su poder y cómo va a cambiar la vida de todos los protagonistas.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Carol y Morgan son conducidos hasta una comunidad que parece segura y bien abastecida. Todo resulta tan idílico, que la desconfianza ante lo que están presenciando aflora en ellos.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Negan mantiene a Daryl encerrado en una celda, pero le propone que se someta a él y pasará a disfrutar de los privilegios de los que gozan los suyos. Se descubre el pasado de Dwight y por qué tiene la cara desfigurada.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Los miembros del grupo de Alejandría están desmoralizados debido a los trágicos acontecimientos que acaban de ocurrir, pero al mismo tiempo deben prepararse para el encuentro con Negan. Este llega antes de lo previsto y les arrebata las armas.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Afligidas por la pena y rodeadas de enemigos, Maggie y Sasha tratan de encontrar seguridad en Hilltop, pero allí no son bien recibidas por todos. En ese momento, los hombres de Negan llegan a Hilltop, adonde también se dirigen Carl y Enid.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Tara llega a un poblado en el que solo viven unas peligrosas mujeres que no la dejarán salir de ahí fácilmente. Mientras tanto, Heath, quien la acompañaba en la búsqueda de provisiones, se pierde tratando de escapar de un ataque zombi.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Carl se separa de Jesús y llega, oculto en un camión, a la guarida de los Saviors con la intención de matar a Negan. Mientras tanto, Rosita fuerza a Eugene a que le fabrique una bala y Michonne pone en marcha su propio plan contra Negan.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Negan continúa su visita a Alejandría. Spencer trata de entablar amistad con él para que lo designe líder de la comunidad, en lugar de Rick. Pero en ese momento Rick llega y se desencadena una serie de acontecimientos.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Guiados por Jesús, Rick y sus compañeros llegan hasta la comunidad del rey Ezequiel, para buscar aliados en su lucha contra Negan. Allá se reencuentran con un viejo conocido.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Mientras buscan a Gabriel, Rick y el grupo se topan con una misteriosa región cuyos habitantes son completamente diferentes a todo lo que han conocido hasta ahora.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Eugene, ahora en el cuartel general de los Salvadores, tiene que demostrar a Negan que vale la pena mantenerlo vivo. Mientras, Dwight es culpado de que Sherry haya permitido la fuga de Daryl y Negan le da una última oportunidad: encontrar a Sherry.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo de Rick busca provisiones y armas con las que contentar a sus nuevos aliados en la lucha contra Negan. Mientras, Rosita está cada vez más impaciente por comenzar la guerra y en Alexandria, Tara deberá tomar una decisión trascendental.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Carol visita el Reino e interroga a Morgan. Las tensiones llegan a un punto crítico cuando el grupo de Ezequiel les entrega provisiones a los Salvadores.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Los Salvadores visitan Hilltop inesperadamente, sorprendiendo a todo el mundo, y su intención va más allá de la de cobrar el pago de suministros. Además, Rosita y Sasha se dirigen al campamento de los Salvadores con la intención de asesinar a Negan.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo de Rick lleva a cabo una peligrosa misión para obtener armas de la comunidad de mujeres en la que estuvo Tara, quieran ellas o no cooperar. Además, Negan mantiene cautiva a Sasha.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: La batalla final contra los Salvadores se aproxima, mientras Sasha se encuentra a merced de Negan y Dwight trata de demostrar a Rick que ha sido sincero con ellos y quiere ver a Negan muerto.

programme.title: Interview With the Vampire
programme.desc: Louis narra la odisea de Claudia en busca de vampiros en Europa en mitad de las atrocidades de la Segunda Guerra Mundial.

programme.title: Interview With the Vampire
programme.desc: Armand se une a la entrevista y, junto a Louis, le cuenta a Molloy cómo se conocieron.

programme.title: Interview With the Vampire
programme.desc: Molloy recibe una tentadora oferta proveniente de alguien insospechado. Armand revela el sorprendente origen del Théâtre des Vampires. Louis y Armand rememoran lo vivido en París, mientras Claudia explora la ciudad.

programme.title: Interview With the Vampire
programme.desc: En el Theatre des Vampires, el clan se pregunta por la naturaleza de la relación entre Louis y Armand. Claudia se encuentra batallando con su nuevo trabajo como actriz cuando conoce a una nueva compañía. Molloy se enfrenta a sus propios problemas.

programme.title: Interview With the Vampire
programme.desc: Con ayuda de Louis, Molloy rememora los momentos de su pasado que más daño le hacen durante la primera entrevista que mantienen, en 1973.

programme.title: Interview With the Vampire
programme.desc: En París, Claudia pide un complejo favor a Louis. Mientras tanto, Armand intenta mantener el control dentro de un clan que se encuentra cada vez más inconforme. En Dubái, aumenta la tensión entre Louis y Armand.

programme.title: Interview With the Vampire
programme.desc: El clan abre un juicio cuyo resultado parece escrito antes incluso de comenzar, pero el testigo principal no recita el testimonio que le habían ordenado narrar.

programme.title: Interview With the Vampire
programme.desc: Molloy cuestiona las consecuencias del juicio de Louis y Claudia. Armand es ridiculizado por haber ayudado a Louis.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick y su grupo, junto con los del Reino e Hilltop, están preparados para comenzar la lucha contra Negan y los Salvadores.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Los aliados de Alexandria atacan a la vez diferentes guaridas de los Salvadores, pero estos los superan en número y armamento y la batalla va a ser intensa, cruel y no exenta de bajas.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Con Rick contra las cuerdas, la guerra contra los Saviors se recrudece e Hilltop, el Reino y Alejandría conocen el verdadero potencial del ejército de Negan.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Los Saviors poseen un arma de gran potencia que pretenden transportar para ayudar a Negan. Ezekiel, que ha sobrevivido a la matanza de sus hombres, y Carol, aislada en territorio enemigo, son los únicos que pueden impedir la entrega del arma.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Gabriel y Negan tienen que cooperar para salir con vida de la casa en la que están encerrados, con decenas de muertos vivientes tratando de comérselos. Mientras, los lugartenientes de Negan se dan cuenta de que uno de ellos es un traidor, ¿quién?

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick visita a Jadis para convencerla de que se una a ellos en la lucha contra Negan. En Hilltop, Gregory sugiere a Maggie, que está enojada con Jesús porque está alimentando a los prisioneros, que los ahorque. Carl se encuentra con Siddiq.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Daryl y Tara rompen el muro del Santuario y los zombis entran al recinto. Negan exige a Eugene que idee una manera de sacarlos con vida de allí. Jadis prepara a Rick una muerte horrenda.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Negan y sus hombres atacan a las tres comunidades rebeldes al mismo tiempo. Sin Rick, Carl asume la defensa de Alexandria, cercada por el propio Negan. Mientras, Simon detiene al ejército de Hilltop en la carretera y Gavin quiere capturar a Ezekiel.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Carl hace una última petición a Rick y Michonne antes de morir. Mientras tanto, Morgan y Carol intentan rescatar a Ezekiel antes de que Gavin se lo entregue vivo a Negan para que este lo torture y asesine delante de sus seguidores.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Negan ordena a Simon que mate solo a uno de los hombres de Jadis como escarmiento, pero Simon tiene sed de venganza. Mientras, Rick se dirige al basurero del grupo de Jadis para renovar su alianza, y Aaron sigue intentando obtener un acuerdo.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: A Maggie se le acaban las reservas de alimentos y debe decidir si deja que los presos pasen hambre. Mientras, Daryl guía a los supervivientes de Alejandría a través de un pantano repleto de zombis, y la adversidad pone a prueba la fe de Gabriel.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick ataca a Negan cuando este se dirigía a Hilltop y terminan enfrentándose en un edificio abandonado, pero Simon y Dwight siguen el rastro de Negan. Mientras tanto, Maggie, Enid, Michonne y Rosita discuten sobre la propuesta de una desconocida.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Los Saviors, ahora dirigidos por Simon, atacan Hilltop pese a que algunos de sus combatientes están dentro, presos. Maggie organiza la defensa del poblado, pero ¿podrán evitar una masacre como la que Simon perpetró contra el grupo de Jadis?

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Jadis planea una muerte horrenda para Negan. Mientras, Morgan va en busca de Henry y Rick sale de Hilltop para cazar a los que huyeron durante el asalto comandado por Simon. Finalmente, los dos se encuentran en territorio enemigo.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Mientras los hombres de Negan continúan con su ofensiva, Aaron sigue buscando aliados nuevos, pese a que pueda costarle la vida. Daryl y Rosita se enfrentan a un viejo amigo.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Las comunidades unen sus fuerzas en la última batalla contra los Salvadores. Negan ha conseguido entregar a Rick un mapa con instrucciones, para así tenderle una emboscada.

programme.title: Mayfair Witches
programme.desc: La neurocirujana Rowan Fielding mata con la mente cuando se enfada. Su búsqueda de respuestas la lleva hacia su reservada familia biológica. En Nueva Orleans, Deirdre Mayfair está desesperada por escapar de la opresiva casa de su tía.

programme.title: Mayfair Witches
programme.desc: Destrozada por el dolor de la muerte de Ellie, Rowan está fuera de control e incapacitada para realizar cirugías, su paranoia de que alguien la sigue resulta cierta. Deirdre y su misterioso compañero Lasher trabajan juntos para atraer a Rowan a casa.

programme.title: Mayfair Witches

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: John le muestra sus partes íntimas a su jefa en una campaña contra el cáncer de testículos, ella queda impactada. Además, una joven casi muere por la obsesión de su hermano con la seguridad.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Andrés no acepta el lesbianismo de su hija, ella le miente y él pide 30 mil dólares. Michael quiere que su madre entregue a su sobrina a servicios sociales, pues no es apta para cuidarla.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Junior quiere que se reconozca la paternidad del hijo que tiene con Emily. Por otro lado, Marlon fue engañado por Paula, quien le hizo creer que lo amaba y que estaba siendo abusada.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Cristian quiere ser el tutor de su madre inhabilitada porque su padre la maltrata. Odette adoptó a Claudia, la niña de su amiga, pero descubrió que en realidad es su verdadera hija.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Bárbara quiere la custodia de sus hijas, por eso refina su vocabulario. También, Alicia le tiende una trampa a su esposo en un crucero, él pierde el control y lo detienen, ahora será deportado.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El marido de Karla recibe una orden de deportación por culpa de Mirza, quien llamó a la policía porque ellos viven del gobierno. Leonel envía a la cárcel al esposo de Mariposa, su amante.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Omar va a Cuba y entrega una casa a cambio de su boda con Lorena, ahora quiere el divorcio. Luisa toma fotografías y videos de mujeres en baños públicos y luego los expone en galerías de arte.

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.desc: In this episode, we explore Zunya, an eco-village, and its enchanting blue zone concept. We delve into communal living, uncovering its allure. At La Senda, we experience soul cleansing Temazcal and a sublime cacao ceremony. We engage in a farm-to-table activity, savouring locally sourced ingredients. Cala Luna offers a rejuvenating body treatment amidst serene surroundings. We encounter the Maleku Tribes, witnessing their dance ceremony and visiting their cacao farm. The journey concludes with a breath taking hike and a majestic volcano view, reminding us of nature's beauty. This episode is a transformative adventure of self-discovery, cultural immersion, and connection with nature.

programme.title: Great Destinations Asia
programme.desc: Great Destinations of the World takes you to some of the most beautiful and exotic places on the planet. With unbelievable views and fascinating commentary, you will discover these exquisite destinations hold more history than you ever imagined. Travel to picturesque locations in America, Africa, Asia, and Europe. Learn the history of each place, delight in the local cuisine, listen to native music, and leave with feeling like you just experienced some of the most exciting places on the planet.

programme.title: Sarah Graham’s Food Safari
programme.desc: Food blogger and cookbook author, Sarah Graham, takes her kitchen on the road through Africa.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.desc: The State of the Presidi is a swampy, malarial land, which, thanks only to human resilience and intelligence, became a centre of wealth and culture. The journey starts from the Metalliferous Hills of Maremma, rich in raw metals and the historical capital of mining territory, and continues to the historical buildings and the ancient water springs of Massa Maratima with its famous Fertility Tree.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: In the premiere of It's A Beautiful World, Jeff Fuchs joins a team of doctors as they navigate the vast waterways of the Amazon River to deliver vital healthcare to remote Indigenous communities. Set in the tri-border region between Colombia, Brazil, and Peru, this episode offers a powerful look at medicine, resilience, and human connection in one of the most isolated places on Earth.

programme.title: American Travelers
programme.desc: Dave and Kari take their viewers on a tour of the South Western states of the United States.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Arriving at the stunning resort of LUX* Belle Mare, Brent is amazed by their stylish, contemporary spin on luxury hospitality. Surrounded by tropical gardens and pristine white beaches, this is what everyone imagines Mauritius to be and more. He meets up with Chef Nicolas where they cook up a seafood specialty which they then enjoy under the sun on the beach. With a reef nearby, Brent rents a glass bottomed kayak and paddles out to check out the sea life. Then hopping on a bicycle, he rides to a nearby market to get the ingredients he needs for his take on a Chef Nicolas's dish, Mauritian lobster rolls, which he prepares under shady palms.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Brian and Nick ride to Hunter/Tannersville, NY where they overcome their fear of heights. Then it's off to experience classic Italian cuisine, local cheeses and painted ladies!

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Brian and Nick are back out on the road again and pull into the beautiful town of Bristol, New Hampshire. Join them as they hit the Cog Railway to the summit of Mt. Washington, explore the world's cleanest lake, relive their youth in a classic arcade museum, and visit with some critters native to the area!

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Nick & Brian road trip to the great state of Michigan to the lakeside town of Grand Haven. Join them as they head out with the Coast Guard, meet an award winning brewmaster, go behind the scenes of a massive water fountain show, find a blueberry haven, and experience the delectable work of some incredible sandwich artisans!

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Nick checks out the beautiful waterfront town of Scituate, Massachusetts. He experiences sport fishing, Irish mossing, homemade ice cream and lobster mac and cheese. Then he climbs the most expensive, musical water tower in the world.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Nick is on the road again and this time to a town that is right on the Erie Canal. Lockport, New York! He experiences a day in the life of a legendary Buffalo Bills fan. Then he chows down at Danny Sheehan's Steak House before exploring the underworld at the Lockport Caves.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: This town is right on the banks of the Potomac River. Join Brian and Nick as they hit The Bavarian Inn, explore the town's history, make gourmet popcorn, and visit the battlefield that is known as The Bloodiest Day in American History.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Nick road trips to actress Katharine Hepburn's hometown of Old Saybrook. He tours The Kate, learns what the locals are doing to revive the oyster beds, cooks up some sea scallops at Liv's, and hits the shores in search of oystercatchers.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Wellsboro PA aka The Town That Saved Christmas is a classic storybook town with nostalgic gas-lit streets. Nick quickly finds out about its glassmaking past and comes across a chocolate factory with an incredible mission. He chows down at the Steak House and travels deep into the PA Grand Canyon!

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Nick rolls into to this central pa town and visits the historic Campus Theater where he satisfies one of his life long quests. Then he checks out a restaurant that has mastered the art of the smashburger! He'll witness the making of some of the best snowboards in the world, then close out this road trip by hitting Mecum's Auto Auction where the Caddy awaits him after its new restoration.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: This gem in the beautiful Mountain State is known for its connection to John Brown's raid. Hop in the seat and ride along as Nick travels back in time to a candy store that uses centuries old recipes and chows down at a restaurant specializing in vegan delights. Then take a walk on the Appalachian Trail with an AT Legend!

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: This historic town northwest of Boston played a significant role in the American Revolutionary War. Come along as Nick explores the Minuteman National Historical Park, visits the Concord Museum, and takes a stroll through Authors Ridge, the resting place of famous authors such as Henry David Thoreau and Ralph Waldo Emerson. Discover the rich history of this charming New England town.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.desc: According to mythology, Anagni was established by Saturn himself in an area surrounded by huge calcareous walls. Historically, we know that the town was conquered by the Roman Empire at the beginning of the IV century B.C. Even though it was influenced by the Holy See, during the Middle Age Anagni was a free town where two families, the Caetanis and the Colonnas, fought hard for supremacy.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: Before departing La Chorrera, Jeff takes time to explore Juan Alan Muñoz’s remarkable floating hospital—a lifeline for remote Amazonian communities. Onboard, Jeff witnesses eye surgeries, dental procedures, and vital health and nutrition services being delivered to those with no other access to medical care. As the boat prepares for its 400-mile journey, this episode offers an inspiring look at grassroots healthcare in one of the most inaccessible regions on Earth.

programme.title: American Travelers
programme.desc: Dave & Kari visit the small Caribbean island of Nevis near Saint Kitts.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Mauritians have a passion for tea. Their esteem and adoration almost match that of the British. Vanilla tea in particular, is a staple in Mauritian house-holds. Brent begins his journey into the history of this grand love affair at Bois Cheri Tea Factory, home to some of the oldest tea fields on the island. After learning how tea goes from a leafy bush to a brew-able bag he gets to experience the various flavours at a tea tasting with a view. Brent then meets up with a Mauritian local, Aurelie, at Flaq market to buy ingredients for a tea dish she is going to teach him. It's a beautiful day and, regardless of his fear of heights, Brent decides to fit in some parasailing before the cook. He then heads to Cap Malheureux where he and Aurelie cook her mother's tea chicken dish.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: En la agencia siguen con la repartición de regalos. Olegario y Junior están acompañando a Fabián que está sumamente triste por no estar pasándola con su Finita e hijas. En la agencia siguen con los regalos. Ana ya le regaló a Pastor y Pastor a Mauricio. Lolita y Dionisia quieren atender a ROKUro como un rey. El tiene pena. Carolina sigue pensando en el beso de Segundo y viendo la hora que es y Juan Diego no la llama. Juan Diego le regala a Yubiri y se abrazan.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Gabriel conoce a Magdalena. Ella es la encargada de sacarle las fotos para la campaña publicitaria. Es muy dulce y queda enganchado con ella. Epicúreo va a entrevistar a Valentina Pacheco, pero con una información errónea. Y ella empieza a pensar en la hija que tuvo y dio, mediante fecundación in Vitro. Julieta siente que está defraudando a sus padres, por trabajar en un periódico de chimentos. Angie (esposa de Gabriel) está muy enojada porque él apaga su teléfono y no consigue localizarlo. Magdalena invita a Sofía (su ginecóloga) a cenar a su casa para ver si existe la posibilidad de tener otro hijo. Agustín se enoja con Sofía (que es su amante). Ya que le había pedido que dijera que eso era imposible, sin embargo Sofía afirma lo contrario.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Moisés descubre la verdad sobre su padre biológico y confronta a Benjamín. Alejandro confiesa que no es cura. La muerte de la Nona en Italia sacude a todos, mientras Katiuska y Hortensia conspiran con Benjamín para robar el testamento y asegurar la herencia. Manuela enfrenta insultos de su familia tras dar la noticia de la muerte. Entre tensiones familiares y revelaciones de secretos del pasado, los personajes lidian con el caos, el alcoholismo y la ambición por la fortuna.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Isaías culpa a Eustoquio de su pasada estancia en cárcel por los dólares falsos. Alejandro engaña a Arminda haciéndola creer en una cita; Consuelo se prepara. Eustoquio manipula a Isaías ofreciéndole dinero para pagarle a Adolfo. José Luis prepara una operación comando con sus amigos para rescatar a Natalia. El médico informa a Adolfo y Marisela que a Junior le queda poco tiempo de vida. Consuelo amenaza con matar a Arminda; ella revela que la hija está viva. Carmen Rosa se ahoga en sus recuerdos del pasado. Leticia descubre que su carro no tiene frenos y entra en pánico.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Carlos Ernesto y Leonardo hablan acerca de las sospechas del segundo sobre la verdadera paternidad de Mateo, el hijo de Irene. Sin que ellos lo sepan, Rebeca los está escuchando. Virginia y Jimena se reconcilian y le comunican la buena nueva a Carlos Ernesto, quien se muestra feliz y agradecido. Leo es liberado de la cárcel y se reencuentra con su padre. En una molesta discusión, pregunta si cuando se vuelvan a casar, van a firmar la separación de bienes. Sandra invita a salir a Fernando para poder mostrarle que María Lucía está de novia y muy feliz con Damián. Trinidad le cuenta a Zulay la propuesta de Anzola y Zulay la insta a aceptarla. Al mismo tiempo, Anzola se lamenta con Coromoto por la negativa de Trinidad.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Heriberto logra escapar de la cárcel y le pasa información a Maricielo sobre el posible escondite al que Reina irá con Alejandro. La policía consigue dar con los secuestradores y recuperar sano y salvo a Alejandro, pero Reina se da a la fuga. A último momento, es interceptada por las patrullas. Luego, Heriberto se dirige a la casa de Sol y le dice que ha ayudado a la policía para recuperar a Alejandro. Ella confía en él pero, al momento de brindar, Heriberto le pone una droga en su bebida.
